title: Chromatic polynomial of a tree
statement: Let $G$ be a tree on a finite, nonempty vertex set with $\nu$ vertices, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Then the number of distinct proper $k$-colourings of $G$ is \[\pi_k(G) = k(k-1)^{\nu-1}.\]
hypotheses_covered: G is a tree (connected and acyclic)
nu is the number of vertices
replaced:

\texttt{$\pi$\_k(G) = k(k-1)\textasciicircum{}\{$\nu$-1\}}.}
